title: Meeting Magz

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Too bad. Unfortunately it's not going to happen. The church's coder cancelled last minute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad. Unfortunately it's not going to happen. The church's coder cancelled last minute.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: The Church of the Binary God? The coders behind the Scripture of Ones and Zeros.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Church of the Binary God? The coders behind the Scripture of Ones and Zeros.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: You either have a good day (one) or a bad day (zero). If you can find the ones then you're doing alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You either have a good day (one) or a bad day (zero). If you can find the ones then you're doing alright.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's the bedrock of life, like down to the very core of it all. Simple ones and zeros. Yes and no. Dead or alive. We've just complicated everything to a point where it's almost unrecognizable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's the bedrock of life, like down to the very core of it all. Simple ones and zeros. Yes and no. Dead or alive. We've just complicated everything to a point where it's almost unrecognizable.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Ummm, we're not exactly a fan of the C-word. That sort of closed mindedness is what has us existing in this mess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ummm, we're not exactly a fan of the C-word. That sort of closed mindedness is what has us existing in this mess.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Did you come here for the sermon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you come here for the sermon?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Nova was set to preach today. A throwback to the first scripts, when the Church of the Binary God was nothing more than a weekly meeting at a LAN cafe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nova was set to preach today. A throwback to the first scripts, when the Church of the Binary God was nothing more than a weekly meeting at a LAN cafe.
We have a storied history.
What's it all about?
What is it then?
Not sold.
Gray areas are good though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Agreed. We need to simplify everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agreed. We need to simplify everything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Agreed. We need to simplify everything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Agreed. We need to simplify everything.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Are they though? Really? I gotta go, but maybe you could come see me at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. I'd be interested to talk about the gray.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are they though? Really? I gotta go, but maybe you could come see me at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. I'd be interested to talk about the gray.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: "Peace is coded in absolutes." I have to go, but come see me down at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. We can look at the ones and zeros.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Peace is coded in absolutes." I have to go, but come see me down at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. We can look at the ones and zeros.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's actually very simple. Scripture tells us that life is a series of ones and zeros. You either wake up (one) or you don't (zero).

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's actually very simple. Scripture tells us that life is a series of ones and zeros. You either wake up (one) or you don't (zero).
What about snoozing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if I wake up inside a dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if I wake up inside a dream?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if I wake up inside a dream?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if I wake up inside a dream?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Woah. I'm not looking for a cult.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah. I'm not looking for a cult.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Woah. I'm not looking for a cult.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Woah. I'm not looking for a cult.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds intense.
That kind of makes sense.
Yes.
No.
What sermon?
LAN cafe? Old school.
The church of what?
